en.name: Polenta, frozen
en.summary: Frozen polenta keeps 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality, and 5 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below after thawing. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well beyond the window — what runs out is texture, as the starch gel weeps water on thawing.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage. Cooked polenta is a wet, low-acid starch — the same category of food as cooked rice — so a block left out is in the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) and follows the two-hour rule, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Do not leave a block on the counter to soften before slicing; slice it while it is still firm and cold, which is easier anyway.
en.fridge: 5 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below after thawing, kept covered or wrapped so the surface does not dry into a skin. Thawed polenta firms up considerably in the fridge, which is a feature rather than a fault: a cold block slices cleanly into slabs for grilling or frying, where soft polenta would collapse. Expect a little water to separate out; pour it off rather than stirring it back in.
en.freezer: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously at −18 °C it stays safe indefinitely; the window describes quality. What degrades is the starch gel — freezing forces water out of it, so a long-frozen block thaws wetter and slightly grainier than it went in. Slice it into portions before freezing, interleave with paper so you can take one at a time, and wrap tightly with the air excluded to keep the surface from freezer-burning.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, or cook slices straight from frozen on a hot griddle or in an oven, which works well and avoids the wateriness entirely. Never thaw on the counter. Polenta thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss; anything thawed warm must not be.
spoilage: A sour or fermented smell, which is the clearest sign for a cooked starch.
A slimy or tacky surface on a thawed block.
Any mould spot — discard the whole block, do not trim it.
Dry white patches and a crumbly texture after long freezing — freezer burn.
tips: Slice into portions before freezing; a frozen block is hard to cut.
Interleave slices with baking paper so they peel apart.
Grill or fry slices straight from frozen for the best texture.
Pour off any separated water rather than stirring it back in.

faq.q: How long does frozen polenta last?
faq.a: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe beyond that; the window is about texture.

faq.q: How long does thawed polenta keep?
faq.a: 5 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered.

faq.q: Can you cook polenta from frozen?
faq.a: Yes, and slices grill or fry very well straight from frozen — it avoids the wateriness that comes with thawing.

zh.name: 冷凍玉米糕
zh.summary: 冷凍玉米糕在 −18 °C 下可保有最佳品質 12 個月；解凍後放 4 °C 以下冷藏 5 天。只要全程沒退冰，超過這個期限仍然安全——先用完的是口感，因為澱粉膠體在解凍時會出水。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存這一項。煮好的玉米糕是濕的低酸澱粉——和熟白飯屬於同一類——所以一塊擺在外面的玉米糕正在 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶裡，適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。也不要為了好切先把它放在檯面上回軟；趁它還冰、還硬的時候切，本來就比較好切。
zh.fridge: 解凍後蓋好或包好，放 4 °C 以下 5 天，免得表面乾出一層皮。解凍過的玉米糕在冷藏會變得相當結實，那是優點不是缺點：一塊冰硬的糕可以切得乾乾淨淨，拿去煎或炙烤；軟的玉米糊一下鍋就散了。它會析出一點水，請倒掉，不要攪回去。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 12 個月品質最好。全程維持在 −18 °C 就一直是安全的；這個期限描述的是品質。會退步的是澱粉膠體——冷凍會把水從膠體裡逼出來，所以凍久了的那塊解凍後會比原本更濕、口感略粗。冷凍前先切成一份一份，中間夾紙好一次取一片，並包緊、擠掉空氣，避免表面凍燒。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，或把切片直接從冷凍放上熱鍋、送進烤箱——這樣效果很好，而且完全避開出水的問題。絕對不要在檯面上解凍。在冷藏解凍、且維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；回溫過的絕對不行。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有發酵味，這是熟澱粉最明確的訊號。
解凍後表面黏滑或黏手。
只要出現霉點就整塊丟掉，不要切掉那一角。
冷凍太久出現乾白斑塊、質地變碎——那是凍燒。
tips: 冷凍前先切成一份一份；整塊凍硬很難切。
切片之間夾烘焙紙，才撕得開。
切片直接從冷凍煎或炙烤，口感最好。
析出的水倒掉，不要攪回去。

faq.q: 冷凍玉米糕可以放多久？
faq.a: −18 °C 下 12 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰放更久仍然安全；這個期限講的是口感。

faq.q: 解凍後的玉米糕可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 5 天。

faq.q: 玉米糕可以從冷凍直接煮嗎？
faq.a: 可以，切片直接從冷凍煎或炙烤效果很好，而且避開了解凍會出水的問題。
